title: Calendar
overview: This guide covers calendar workflows for Provider.

subtasks.title: Calendar Setting menu (sidebar)
subtasks.purpose: Expose the three Calendar Setting entry points — Visit Type, Working Hours and Calendar.

steps.title: Open Calendar Menu
steps.description: Click Calendar in the left sidebar.

steps.title: Choose Calendar Option
steps.description: Pick Visit Type to manage visit-type presets, Working Hours to set weekly availability, or Calendar to view / book appointments.

steps.title: Close the Flyout
steps.description: Click outside the flyout to close it. Notes The red dot on Calendar indicates upcoming appointments in the next 24 hours.

subtasks.title: Visit Type List
subtasks.purpose: Maintain the practice’s reusable visit-type presets (name, description, duration, colour, status) so calendar bookings share a consistent taxonomy.

steps.title: Open Visit Type List
steps.description: Click Calendar → Visit Type.

steps.title: Search Visit Types
steps.description: Use the Search box (top-right) to filter existing visit types.

steps.title: Add Visit Type
steps.description: Click + Add Visit Type (top-right, blue) to open the Add modal.

steps.title: Enter Visit Type Details
steps.description: Enter Visit Type name (e.g., “30-min Follow-up”), Description, Duration in minutes and pick a Color chip.

steps.title: Set Status & Save
steps.description: Set Status Active and click Save — the new row appears in the grid.

steps.title: Edit or Delete Visit Type
steps.description: Use the row Action to edit, deactivate or delete an existing preset.

steps.title: Page Through Visit Types
steps.description: Change Show N entries and use the pager (bottom-right) to navigate. Notes Visit-type Colour is what renders on the Calendar day / week grid — pick distinct colours per common visit. Deactivating a visit type hides it from new bookings but leaves historical appointments intact.

subtasks.title: Working Hours
subtasks.purpose: Set the weekly availability window per day (with optional split shifts) that the Calendar honours when offering booking slots.

steps.title: Open Working Hours
steps.description: Click Calendar → Working Hours.

steps.title: Toggle Day Active
steps.description: For each day (Mon – Sun), toggle the day Active / Inactive.

steps.title: Set Start & End Time
steps.description: For active days, set the primary start and end time (e.g., 09:00 AM – 05:00 PM).

steps.title: Add Split Shift
steps.description: If a split shift is needed, click + Add Shift and enter the second start / end.

steps.title: Copy Schedule from Day
steps.description: Copy from another day using the “Copy from” dropdown when the same schedule applies.

steps.title: Save Working Hours
steps.description: Click Save to persist the week. Notes Inactive days are removed from the Calendar picker and the booking availability API. Split shifts are useful for lunch breaks — the gap between shifts is treated as unavailable.

subtasks.title: Calendar (view & book appointments)
subtasks.purpose: View, create, reschedule or cancel appointments across day / week / month views.

steps.title: Open Calendar Grid
steps.description: Click Calendar → Calendar to open the grid (default view: current week).

steps.title: Toggle Day/Week/Month View
steps.description: Toggle between Day / Week / Month views using the view switch (top-right).

steps.title: Navigate the Calendar
steps.description: Use the ‹ / › arrows or Today to navigate.

steps.title: Book an Appointment
steps.description: Click an empty slot to open the Add Appointment form — pick Patient, Visit Type, System Caregiver / Provider, Start, End, Notes — then Save.

steps.title: View, Reschedule, or Edit
steps.description: Click an existing appointment to view detail; drag to reschedule or click Edit to change time / attendees.

steps.title: Cancel Appointment
steps.description: Click Cancel Appointment to remove and notify the patient. Notes Only slots inside the configured Working Hours are clickable — greyed slots are outside availability. Rescheduling triggers an automatic patient notification per the practice’s SMS / email preferences. Task 8.6 — Messages
